page_title: ATA 0-1 INT | Atalanta v Inter 28/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90+2' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting corner from Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) is cleared by the defence.
90' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Atalanta win a corner.
88' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
87' This would have been a magnificent goal from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the left post.
86' Carlos Augusto (Inter) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
84' Substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) on for Piotr Zielinski.
83' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Lautaro Martinez will be replaced by Andy Diouf (Inter).
82' Luis Henrique (Inter) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
80' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) for a tough tackle.
80' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

79' A lofted cross from Yunus Musah (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
78' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
77' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Federico La Penna didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Dimarco departs the field of play to be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
76' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) replacing Nicolo Barella.
75' Substitution. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) has come on for Sead Kolasinac.
74' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

74' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
71' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Federico La Penna saw the whole situation.
69' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
67' Neat passing move from Inter in order to create new attacking opportunities.
65' 0 - 1 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.
65' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) replaces Nicola Zalewski.
64' Substitution. Marcus Thuram leaves the pitch and is replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
63' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) has a goal ruled out for offside!
60' 38:62 – the latest ball possession ratio.
58' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Mario Pasalic and he is replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
57' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
56' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
56' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
55' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
52' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul.
50' Ederson (Atalanta) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
48' Manuel Akanji (Inter) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is about to take a corner kick.
48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
47' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Federico La Penna interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' Substitution. Davide Zappacosta did his best and is replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Federico La Penna couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) and blew his whistle.
42' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.
42' Federico Dimarco (Inter) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

41' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
40' The corner kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
39' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Inter have a corner.
38' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
37' The goal by Inter is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
36' Wait! Referee Federico La Penna has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

35' Goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. Lautaro Martinez assisted in the goal. 0:1.
34' Yann Bisseck (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
33' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
32' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
31' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
29' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
28' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
28' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner with a short pass.
26' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
25' The ball is played back to Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.
24' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yann Sommer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
23' Marcus Thuram (Inter) drives a shot towards the right side of the goal from inside the box, but Marco Carnesecchi leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
22' Luis Henrique (Inter) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored!
21' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
19' The foul by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Federico La Penna.
17' The ball unexpectedly rebounds out to Ederson (Atalanta) on the edge of the box, but his attempt is lame and ends up well wide of the right post.
17' An attempted cross from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is cleared.
15' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
14' Inter exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. It's a throw-in for Atalanta.
13' Manuel Akanji (Inter) is penalised for holding. Federico La Penna signals a set piece.
12' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
10' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
9' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but it's cleared.

9' Manuel Akanji (Inter) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.
8' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

8' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
6' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
5' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Inter will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Federico La Penna.
